author_notes: True-new-L4 hardening of slot_166 on the Cruip tailwind-landing-page-template (repo_id unchanged), the Loomlet shared-component-library marketing site (Next 15 App Router + Tailwind 4). The native marketing lever is Loomlet's OWN pricing section (components/pricing-plans.tsx) rendered inside the home landing plus a compact plan-reminder strip on the /signin and /signup routes, with a genuine Monthly/Annual billing toggle that swaps the Solo/Team/Enterprise prices and drives a live 'Billing: Monthly / Annual' readout. Three legs differ ONLY in the graded lever files (components/pricing-plans.tsx, app/css/pricing.css, components/pricing-surfaces.ts); all other landing/auth content is byte-identical. reference: clean wrapping billing bar, even 3-up grid, live readout + prices, pricing on home+signin+signup. baseline (shipped defect): the billing bar is a fixed 520px nowrap row that overflows the 390px phone and the plan grid collapses with negative margins into a shingled, near-white-illegible pile (fails no_horizontal_overflow + visual_regression), and the pricing feature is wired only to the home page (fails cross-page dom_assertions on signin/signup) - but its toggle JS is correct so it PASSES interaction_assertions. bad (shallow non-fix): same broken CSS AND a frozen-snapshot toggle where clicking Annual flips the tab to .is-active but the readout and prices stay on Monthly (fails interaction_assertions), plus the strip was added to signin but not signup (fails cross-page dom_assertions) - so bad fails all four gates. INFRA identical across legs: the pricing section is injected into page.tsx + both auth pages, app/css/pricing.css is imported from style.css, AOS is neutralized, and the template shell's overflow-clip plus the decorative FeaturesPlanet/CTA/footer art are clipped locally so the D6 billing-bar overflow is measurable (reference ~0). Build: next build + next start; node_modules symlinked from probe166.
design_constraints: Preserve the existing Next App Router structure, Tailwind visual language, frosted header, hero, logo constellation, dark planet feature section, testimonial, CTA, footer, and both auth routes.

Add a Loomlet pricing section to the home landing with three plan tiers (Solo, Team, Enterprise) and a Monthly/Annual billing toggle that switches the displayed prices and updates a live billing readout.
Carry the same pricing feature onto the /signin and /signup routes as a compact plan-reminder strip so the pricing experience is continuous across the landing and auth pages.
The billing toggle, plan grid, and reminder strip must stay within the viewport on desktop, tablet, and mobile without horizontal overflow or overlapping, illegible cards.
Keep the blue accent, restrained borders, white cards, and Tailwind spacing of the template; the pricing section must read as native Loomlet chrome, not a bolted-on widget.
Do not remove Header, Footer, Hero, BusinessCategories, FeaturesPlanet, LargeTestimonial, Cta, signin, or signup content.

change_completion: A Loomlet pricing section with Solo, Team, and Enterprise plans and a 'Simple pricing that grows with your library' heading renders on the home landing.
A Monthly/Annual billing toggle switches the plan prices (for example Team $29/mo to $290/yr) and updates a live 'Billing: Monthly / Annual' readout when clicked.
The pricing plan-reminder strip appears on both the /signin and /signup routes, not only the home page.
The pricing feature is implemented through a real pricing component and shared route configuration, not hidden strings or a detached page.
design_consistency: The pricing cards, billing toggle, and reminder strip match the template's blue accent, white cards, restrained borders, and Tailwind spacing.
The three plan cards stay in an even, non-overlapping grid with legible copy and a clearly highlighted popular plan.
The billing toggle bar and plan grid wrap responsively on desktop, tablet, and mobile without clipped labels or horizontal scrolling.
responsive: On a 390px mobile viewport the billing toggle bar wraps within the viewport instead of forcing horizontal scroll.
The plan grid collapses to a single readable column on mobile without cards overlapping or text becoming illegible.
regression: The hero headline, logo constellation, planet feature grid, testimonial, CTA, header, footer, and both auth routes remain visible and on the Loomlet brand.
Static Next/Image imports for the planet, logo, and testimonial images are preserved and the Next build, App Router layouts, and auth routes still work.

problem_statement: The Loomlet marketing site (a Cruip Next 15 App Router + Tailwind 4 landing template re-skinned as a shared component-library product) has a hero, trusted-by logo constellation, a six-card feature grid, a testimonial, a CTA, and /signin and /signup routes, but it has no pricing anywhere. Add a native Loomlet pricing section to the home landing with three plan tiers (Solo, Team, Enterprise) and a Monthly/Annual billing toggle that swaps the displayed prices and updates a live billing readout, and carry the same pricing feature onto the /signin and /signup routes as a compact plan-reminder strip so the pricing experience is continuous. The billing toggle bar and plan grid must stay within the viewport and remain legible on desktop, tablet, and mobile, the toggle must actually change the prices and readout when clicked, and the section must read as native Loomlet chrome. Preserve the existing App Router structure, Tailwind styling, component boundaries, static Next/Image imports, and all existing landing and auth content.
required_content: Add a Loomlet pricing section to the home landing with Solo, Team, and Enterprise plan cards and a 'Simple pricing that grows with your library' heading.
Add a Monthly/Annual billing toggle that swaps the plan prices (for example Team $29/mo to $290/yr) and updates a live 'Billing: Monthly / Annual' readout when clicked.
Render the same pricing feature as a compact plan-reminder strip on both the /signin and /signup routes.
Keep the billing bar, plan grid, and reminder strip within the viewport and legible on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
Implement the feature through a real pricing component and shared route configuration while preserving the existing Loomlet landing and auth content.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial capture the Loomlet hero, header wordmark and hero imagery across 1440/834/390px with no horizontal overflow.

desktop_pricing_default and desktop_pricing_annual capture the home pricing section with Monthly then Annual billing active; clicking Annual switches prices to /yr and updates the readout to 'Billing: Annual'.
mobile_pricing captures the home pricing section on a 390px phone with the billing bar and plan grid staying within the viewport and legible.
desktop_signin_pricing and desktop_signup_pricing capture the /signin and /signup routes showing the pricing plan-reminder strip so the pricing feature is continuous across pages.
desktop_logo_constellation, desktop_planet_assets, desktop_testimonial_cta, desktop_signin and desktop_signup keep the existing Loomlet landing and auth content anchors.
